If it does, it throws an IOException (a checked exception) with the message 'name found twice:' followed by the name. The method signature declares 'throws IOException', indicating that the exception is intended to be propagated to the caller. The logic flow ensures that only after successfully parsing the entire line and accumulating polygons does the method check for duplicates and possibly throw. The exception represents a semantic error in the input data (duplicate polygon name), which the calling code is expected to handle appropriately, likely by informing the user or skipping the duplicate.
